parallel.requirements: Recognized pure Node.js ESM `.mjs` output, local imports only, no npm, no `node:crypto`, manual argparse parity, compact JSON/JWT HS256 behavior, and black-box executable probing.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent observed behavior, then split work across four children: SHA/HMAC, base64url/JSON, argparse, and JWT plus entry file, while retaining final integration and verification.
parallel.implementation: Children wrote distinct modules under `/output/lib` and `/output/test1.mjs`; child 3 depended on sibling contracts and the parent later exercised the assembled output.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The swarm result returned all four child reports; parent verified the combined `/output` tree and final artifact validation listed the expected entry and library files.
parallel.verification: Children ran unit-style harnesses for their modules; parent ran end-to-end comparisons against the executable for samples, Unicode, emoji, escaping, argument forms, help, errors, and forbidden-pattern grep.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Mounted evidence does not expose hidden failing cases or artifact contents beyond write snippets; the official completed evaluation still failed 19 of 70 cases.

serial.requirements: Recognized JWT HS256 migration, ESM `.mjs`, no external dependencies, no crypto helper, manual CLI parsing, output placement in `/output`, and executable-based behavior checks.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single actor owned research, implementation, module assembly, CLI behavior, tests, and final response without delegation or handoff boundaries.
serial.implementation: Serial wrote pure-JS SHA-256, HMAC, base64url, pyjson, JWT, argparse, and `test1.mjs` in one flow, with different internal names such as `hmacSha256.mjs` and `pyjson.mjs`.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The same actor directly assembled imports and entry-file behavior, then delivered an artifact containing `test1.mjs` plus the generated library files.
serial.verification: Serial compared the four sample tokens and several edge cases including Unicode, emoji, escapes, empty payload, `--payload=value`, and missing-payload exit code against the executable.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The mounted status shows the official evaluator failed 19 of 70 cases; visible trajectory evidence does not include the failing testcase details or final artifact tree contents.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel captured the exact prompt constraints and augmented them with executable observations before delegation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial captured the same prompt constraints and probed the executable before writing code.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement difference is visible; both understood the main migration and compliance constraints.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed implementation into four child-owned module groups while the parent owned final integration.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all ownership in the main actor and wrote the complete module set itself.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel-specific difference is delegated module ownership with explicit contracts, not a missing owner.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs included concrete filenames, export signatures, import paths, and behavior facts for shared modules.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used local context only and selected its own internal names and APIs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had cross-agent interfaces but they were explicit and later compatible enough for parent end-to-end checks.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial produced a similar solution but used `hmacSha256.mjs`, `pyjson.mjs`, an `encode` API, and an entry file importing `node:path`.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The implementations differed internally, but both generated hierarchical ESM artifacts and both reached the same official score.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: All four children returned in the swarm aggregate, and the parent acted after receiving those handoffs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child lifecycle; local writes and checks happened in sequence.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a result-join step, but no unreturned or unused child result is visible.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children wrote a shared `/output` tree with distinct file scopes; parent listed the final tree and found only harmless comment grep hits.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote all files itself and artifact validation listed its final tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had shared workspace writes but no observed collision, overwrite, or contamination consequence.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had child-level unit checks plus parent end-to-end comparisons for many payload and CLI cases before finalizing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran sample comparisons and several edge cases, but its visible CLI verification was narrower than the parallel argparse child harness.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification was broader in visible trajectory, yet the official evaluator still failed both solutions equally.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used more time and tokens with four subagents but completed normally and still had final verification time.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed faster with no subagents and no timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The budget difference did not create a visible unfinished parallel stage or a discordant outcome.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations show both modes failed with identical 51/70 quality, so there is no discordant official outcome to explain. Parallel solved through a four-child decomposition followed by parent integration checks; serial solved monolithically with different internal module names and a simpler visible argparse path. Both visible trajectories verified representative examples and edge cases, and the mounted evidence does not expose testcase-level failures or final artifact contents sufficient to isolate the shared hidden defect.
parallel_contributors: Parallel used four completed children with explicit file/interface contracts and parent-level assembled verification before closure.
serial_contributors: Serial implemented and verified all modules in one actor without handoff or merge boundaries.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial used different internal module/API names (`hmacSha256.mjs`, `pyjson.mjs`, `encode`) while parallel used the delegated contract names (`hmac.mjs`, `jsonDumps.mjs`, `encodeJwt`).
Serial visible argparse handling was less comprehensive than the parallel argparse child harness, but both received the same official result.
evaluator_effects: Only aggregate official results are mounted: both `cell/status.json:evaluation` records report 51/70 and solution_passed false, without failing testcase details.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; shared official failure with no retained parallel coordination pattern
